reset_fee: No fixed reset fee published. Rapid Reset (2-Step only): Phase 1 Rapid Rebuy at 40% off the standard price; Phase 2 Continuation and Funded Recovery priced in dashboard. Paid Account Refresh for funded Challenge/Pro accounts near max drawdown (price shown in dashboard).
refund_policy: Challenge: fee refunded automatically if funded and account in net profit on day 30 after funding. Pro: fee refunded once funded and in profit after 30 days. 2-Step Solo: refunded on first approved reward payment. Instant Funding: non-refundable except cooling-off conditions.
min_payout: 1% of initial balance (Instant, no cap); 1-Step Challenge/Pro: lower of 1% or $100; 2-Step Challenge/Pro: no minimum
scaling_plan: Challenge: rolling 90-day cycle, 12% (1-Step)/10% (2-Step) target, ≥50 trades, no single trade >7.5% of profit, 2 of 3 profitable months → +30% balance and higher split (to 95%); per-account cap USD 680,000; max scaled allocation USD 2,040,000 (Challenge/Pro), USD 680,000 (Instant)
ea_bots: allowed (own EAs only; prohibited on 2-Step Solo)
max_risk_per_trade: Per-position drawdown limit 1.25% (1-Step), 1.5% (2-Step/Pro), 1% (Instant); floating drawdown per symbol 2% (Challenge) / 1.5% (Instant) — strike rules
inactivity_rule: Inactivity for 30 consecutive calendar days is prohibited conduct (T&C 7.2)
notes: Copy trading only between accounts the trader owns/controls; third-party signals/copying banned. Cross-account hedging banned; 'hedging' also listed among monitored rules. Weekend holding add-on for Instant (extra cost per size, e.g. $24 on 2.5K Standard); swap-free add-on available at extra cost. Instant page says no time limits; no challenge time limit found in T&C, left null. Activation fee not mentioned for CFD accounts (the 'zero activation fees' claim relates to Finotive Futures). KYC (and possible Enhanced KYC/verification call) required before reward payments. Scalping condition: ≥40% of trades or ≥20% of profit from trades held ≤120s in a payout cycle.
